Tailscale is a private mesh VPN (WireGuard) — it makes your phone and PC act like they're on the same LAN, free for personal use, nothing recurring to forget about. Cloudflare Tunnel can absolutely do this instead (`cloudflared`, free, using the domain/account you already have) — it exposes the dev server through a subdomain behind Cloudflare Access for auth, so you'd be leaning on infra you already know rather than adding a new tool; the trade-off is it's a public(ish) endpoint through Cloudflare's edge rather than a true private network, so it needs Access locked down properly, versus Tailscale's "just works, nothing exposed to the internet at all." Given you already run things through Cloudflare, I'd lean toward trying the Tunnel first.
